headline: Ada County plans $3M landfill pond to cut hauling costs
pages:
Ada County plans to build a new $3 million pond at its landfill to collect leachate, the contaminated liquid that drains from buried trash, before it can reach groundwater, KIVI reported. The landfill generates about 16,000 gallons of leachate a day, and its two existing 6-million-gallon ponds are close to capacity. This year the landfill shipped 1.3 million gallons off site, down from 2.8 million the year before, at a cost of about $1 per gallon. The third pond is expected to be finished by the end of next year. It will be paid for from the landfill's enterprise fund, which comes from dumping fees, and not with taxpayer dollars.
Source: KIVI
